query:
SELECT id,
                    bpm,
                    key AS music_key,
                    escala AS scale,
                    duracion AS duration_seconds,
                    tipo AS sample_type,
                    COALESCE(es_premium, FALSE) AS "is_premium!",
                    COALESCE(tags, '{}') AS "tags!"
             FROM samples
             WHERE eliminado_en IS NULL
               AND estado <> 'eliminado'
               AND (NOT $2 OR embedding IS NULL)
             ORDER BY id
             LIMIT $1
